subject: MATHEMATICS
title: Philippine Money Market
objective: Read and compare schematic peso and centavo amounts.
introduction: One peso equals 100 centavos. Use original tokens, not reproduced banknotes. Explore examples, sort cards, practice, and answer five questions.

vocabulary.definition: Coins and bills we use to buy things.
To look at how things are the same or different.
The main money of the Philippines.
